files.installs/unturned/gamedash-test-run.sh:
#!/bin/bash
# gamedash-managed Unturned server — generated by provision().
# Settings: <ROOT>/installs/unturned/Servers/gd_test/Server/Commands.dat
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
# keep the join password in step with the ones set in GameDash
python3 - "<ROOT>/installs/unturned/Servers/gd_test/Server/Commands.dat" "$GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD" <<'SYNC'
import re, sys
p, pw = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
t = open(p, encoding="utf-8").read()
t = re.sub(r"(?m)^Password .*$", lambda m: "Password " + pw, t)
open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(t)
SYNC
CONSOLE="<ROOT>/installs/unturned/Servers/gd_test/gamedash-console.log.console"
: > "$CONSOLE"
cd "<ROOT>/installs/unturned" || exit 1
# The server's console is fed from the file above, so the dashboard can type
# commands into it (save, say, shutdown).
exec ./ServerHelper.sh +LanServer/gd_test > "<ROOT>/installs/unturned/Servers/gd_test/gamedash-console.log" 2>&1 < <(tail -n0 -F "$CONSOLE")
files.installs/unturned/gamedash-test-stop.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# gamedash-managed graceful stop: ask the server to save and quit, then wait.
echo "shutdown" >> "<ROOT>/installs/unturned/Servers/gd_test/gamedash-console.log.console"
i=0
while [ $i -lt 45 ] && pgrep -f -- '+LanServer/gd_test' >/dev/null; do sleep 1; i=$((i+1)); done
exit 0
